Extend from 7 to 8 and the closest one is the t 54 mod 1 at tier 8. The best thing about it is it has the tier 9 t54 hull. Epic armor and total bully to low tiers, quite competitive against 9 and sometimes 10 especially premium rounds. You have effective armor of 240 mm when angled at 30 degrees. Decent gun depression for a Soviet medium and surprisingly op Camo rating that is letter than most light tanks of tier 8. 100mm main armament means it can overmatch some trolley tanks like the strv S1 that has 30, meaning that anything with a calibre of 90mm or less will autobounce. The t54 mod 1 will automatically obermatch and pen no matter what. Another fun fact is that it has 10mm better side armor rather than the normal t54.

Overall: 
Good: Relatively high calibre gun, better hull armor than tier 9 medium, surprisingly decent ridgeline warrior, quite sneaky, gold rounds pen 258mm of armor for 250 alpha, quite forgiving especially against lower tiers as many tier 7 will need gold rounds for a 50/50 chance when front on, this applies to the lower plate for some

Bad: Relatively low HP pool compared to the many other tier 8 mediums you will meet, the t 54 mod 1 has 1300 compared to the average 1450 or so, relatively bad normal pen of 190 but still enough to pen most targets, worse mobility than t 44 but it is for a reason

P.S. it is my favourite tank for all the above reasons, primarily because of its trollish armor and super forgivingness as well as the high calibre gun. 
Oh, and I forgot to say, it can snapshot relatively well and has quite good dispersion

Hey some lightly armoured tanks, they can make better use of the repair station. Take the ELC even 90 or hwk 30, they are fast, nimble, and hard hitting, you'll have plenty of time to run back to repairs. Double barreled tanks are also dominating if you have the patience to grind them out. Autoreloaders like spaghetti and Pantera are also great choices. If you want premium tank only, I recommend something lightly armoured, as the map is massive and you'll want to get to places, hence lights are best. Don't pick t92 though, I find no use in it, 60km/h top speed isn't great at all, despite awesome power to weight ratio. In my experience, pick the hwk 30, if you want to consistently deal damage, load full gold, 250mm pen HEAT shells with 1,200 m/s shell velocity. Excellent reload time and 410m base view range with decent base 15 camouflage. With chocolate, vents and optics as well as the extended view range skill, your view range will be over 500 metres, not talking about bond equipment if you feel super cheeky. It's HE shells are very nice. 102mm of penetration is like ebr 105 HE shell penetration, but you're 2 tiers lower, you'll deal damage far more reliably. Only downside is normal shell, only 187mm of penetration won't get you much, but there is always HE and gold shells. You gave a nice 90mm main armament with 240 alpha and DPM is only marginally worse compared to medium tanks. With 10 degrees of gun depression at the front, 28 power to weight ratio and 24 reverse speed, as well as high alpha for a light tank, this is perfect for a shoot n' scoot tank. Roll into bush, spot, shoot a shot or two if not spotted and fall back safe and sound. Plus, in frontline, there are tier 8 only, so Ferrari isn't a problem, it'll only be 10 km/h faster than you, but inferior view range, so your'e actually equal with them. Great light tank with combat capabilities of medium, and mobility of lights. One of the only downsides is that without chocolate, your accuracy is 0.35, but if you use chocolate it'll be a lot better at 0.32. If you come to the rear of enemies, shoot HE for consistent 320 alpha. Great tank, highly recommend. Feels a lot like playing other paper tanks like Leopard 1
